pages.article_html:
Lost Fishing Supplies

Level 4 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

Go to the northeast and recover the Lost Fishing Supplies, then return to Oki.

Objectives

Lost Fishing Supplies (0/2)

Description

Oki tells you, "Are you sure that I haven't seen you somewhere before? You seem so familiar." "Regardless, the Kojuko continue to run raids on our villages. We have lost a number of fishing supplies over the past few days, and cannot continue to sustain ourselves without them. Go to the northeast and look for our fishing supplies near the Kojuko portal."

What they say

On offering it

Oki
Are you sure that I haven't seen you somewhere before? You seem so familiar. Regardless, the Kojuko continue to run raids on our villages. We have lost a number of fishing supplies over the past few days, and cannot continue to sustain ourselves without them. Go to the northeast and look for our fishing supplies near the Kojuko portal.

Recorded by quest description.

Notes

There are clickable crates near the Gluttons.

3 recorded disagreements about this quest — level (the Forgotten Horde wiki), next quest (silkyvenom), prev quest (silkyvenom).

Another account

A second source described this quest differently. Both are kept here; neither is a correction of the other.

findings.observation: The page displays level 4, Adventuring, Tanvu, Kojan. Details identifies Oki as starter and hand-in, Tanvu as starting zone, Shang Village series and location -16408, -49970, 187. This matches the coordinate string on Oki's Jewels but does not verify a canonical spawn or coordinate units.

The primary tracker explicitly prints Lost Fishing Supplies (0/2); the fandom variant prints Lost Fishing Supplies (2). Both are preserved as source-specific quantity observations. The summary says recover supplies to the northeast then return to Oki; description places supplies near the Kojuko portal. Notes say there are clickable crates near the Gluttons. No crate ID, spawn coordinates, interaction count or kill requirement is established.

What they say explicitly attributes the offering dialogue to Oki and records it as derived from quest description. The duplicated dialogue is not independent evidence; its statement about raids does not establish a kill objective.

Three disagreements are listed: level attributed to the Forgotten Horde wiki, next quest and prev quest attributed to silkyvenom. Alternative values are absent, and disagreement query URLs were not fetched. Displayed level 4 and navigation remain observations rather than resolved operative facts.

Details lists Previous Avenging Oki and Next Juu (Quest). Oki's Jewels lists Next Lost Fishing Supplies, while Avenging Oki lists Next Oki's Jewels in the prior review chain. The Lost Fishing Supplies Previous link skips Oki's Jewels. These source-specific navigation links and recorded disagreements are preserved without selecting an enforced prerequisite chain.
Repeatable No is explicit. Coin reward 50 has no denomination; no copper value or reward-item identity is inferred.

Source text names thetelonproject.wikidot.com/adventuring-quest:lost-fishing-supplies. Fandom and crawler variants are archive transcriptions, and their original bodies were not fetched in this offline review. Mirrored or duplicated accounts are not independent corroboration.
